newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian upper house to discuss 1997 budget Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: Russian upper house to discuss 1997 budget Feb 12.

text.p: Russia's Federation Council upper house of parliament will discuss the 1997 draft budget at its next session on February 12, a spokeswoman for the Council confirmed on Tuesday.
Last week Itar-Tass news agency said the chamber would discuss the budget on February 4, but it is not meeting on Tuesday, she said.
The budget envisages a deficit of 3.5 percent of Gross Domestic Product, by Russian calculations, on revenues of 434.4 trillion roubles and expenditure of 529.8 trillion roubles.
The State Duma lower house of parliament approved the draft at a fourth final reading on January 24. The draft then passes to the Federation Council for consideration.
It also requires approval by President Boris Yeltsin before becoming law.
